companies.label: Depository bank
companies.economicEvidence: Commercial bank taking deposits and making advances. Net interest income from interest income minus interest expense. Net interest margin and credit cost drive returns.

companies.label: Corporate IT services
companies.economicEvidence: Information technology services company selling consulting volume times price. Revenue from billable volume and realization with gross profit and operating income margins.

companies.label: Insurance underwriter
companies.economicEvidence: Life insurance company underwriting insurance policies. Premiums collected and claims paid with underwriting result and loss ratio plus combined ratio.

companies.label: Office REIT
companies.economicEvidence: Real estate investment trust earning rental income from office properties. Occupancy and lease expiry drive net operating income and funds from operations.

companies.label: Fee-based asset manager
companies.economicEvidence: Asset management company earning management fees on assets under management. Fee rate times average AUM drives advisory fee revenue with operating margin.

companies.label: Diversified conglomerate
companies.economicEvidence: Diversified conglomerate with a portfolio of businesses across energy retail and digital segments. Several distinct multi-segment operations require segmented revenue.
